scientific_question: Does an independent second cohort replicate the H1 soft-gap association and make the controlled H1 contribution identifiable?

relationship_to_v2.separation: Seeds 1350--1399 are new. Their spectra and H1 labels did not exist when this specification was frozen. No threshold, field, offset, observable or control is retuned.

co_primary_endpoints: geometric gap ratio H1-positive versus H1-negative after removing each (cohort,L,delta_Gamma0) stratum mean from log(gap01)
stratified AUC of continuous H1 maximum lifetime for predicting the bottom quartile of gap01 within each (cohort,L,delta_Gamma0) stratum

inference.low_gap_label: gap01 at or below the empirical 25th percentile inside each frozen cohort-by-(L,delta_Gamma0) stratum
inference.resampling_unit: the complete three-delta trajectory of one seed within one L and cohort
inference.permutation_rule: permute complete H1 trajectories among seeds separately within each L and cohort
inference.cluster_bootstrap_rule: resample seed trajectories with replacement separately within each L and cohort
inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the two co-primary one-sided tests at family-wise alpha=0.05
inference.heterogeneity_test: H1-by-cohort interaction with seed-trajectory cluster bootstrap

decision_rule.strong_positive_upgrade: The combined v2+v3 co-primary tests pass after Holm correction, the controlled H1 coefficient has a 95% cluster-bootstrap interval strictly below zero, and there is no significant reversal in the v3 cohort or significant H1-by-cohort heterogeneity.
decision_rule.replicated_limited_positive: The v3 effect has the predicted sign and the combined co-primary tests pass, but the controlled interval still includes zero.
decision_rule.not_replicated: The v3 cohort reverses the association significantly or neither combined co-primary endpoint passes.
decision_rule.guardrail: Analyze all 600 v3 cases together. Do not select favorable sizes or offsets, alter H1 definitions, or inspect partial results.
